feature: Signup welcome and confirmation email with inline public installation QR

unit_tests.scope: Confirmation placeholder priority, public QR and installation URLs, local Supabase template mapping

limitations: HTML browser rendering verified at320/390/1280px, including blocked remote images; actual email-client and signup/confirmation flow tests remain after saving the template in Supabase.
This personalizes the existing automatic signup confirmation email. No separate post-confirmation welcome-mail service or resend to existing members is introduced.
Image is displayed inline from the public site; image-blocking email clients can still use the install button and visible URL.
